parent_session.reason: v01 completed three protected passes and received independent continue decisions, but its literal primary trace and normal visual review still reject acceptance. v02 is a continuity session over this exact mesh, not a rebuild.

candidate.role: immutable topology and volume starting point retained from v01; never likeness authority or direct runtime input

primary_trace.role: sole primary-view likeness, silhouette and landmark authority

topology_policy.starting_mesh: the exact reviewed v01 working mesh plus the original hidden immutable v05 raw mesh and all prior backups
allowed: local face deletion, creation and merge on the existing working surface
local retopology of an existing semantic region

passes.region: existing image-side leading mantle and its connection to the first dorsal chamber
passes.primary_goal: replace the open C-shaped loop with a broad, attached, grounded drape following the locked primary-source edge and negative spaces
passes.diagnostic_goal: keep the drape thick, continuous and integrated with the existing front body without adding a camera card or disconnected geometry

passes.primary_goal: make six overlapping rounded chambers visibly distinct with a tall heavy front and descending rear rhythm
passes.diagnostic_goal: retain a single organic body and shallow, naturally joined saddles rather than a segmented roof or detached balls

passes.region: existing near-side underbody, leg roots and feet
passes.primary_goal: restore a low underbody with thick tapered supports that emerge gradually and land in the source-ground contacts
passes.diagnostic_goal: preserve weight-bearing volume, non-intersecting legs and full-ground contacts

passes.region: existing rear lobe and connected trailing tail surface
passes.primary_goal: turn the hanging rear lobe into an attached, low horizontal fan of subordinate trailing fibres
passes.diagnostic_goal: preserve attached coherent rear volume without debris, a large hanging plate or a competing dorsal mass

passes.region: existing local seams and bumpy overlaps exposed by the preceding audits
passes.primary_goal: remove only clearly non-reference surface noise while retaining the accepted primary contour and all major anatomy
passes.diagnostic_goal: give large volumes a continuous, production-readable organic surface

review_gate.before_each_pass: the declared predecessor must have a local audit receipt and a recorded independent continue decision; the continuation baseline is a reviewed audit-only receipt
review_gate.after_each_pass: capture primary, silhouette, trace, opposite, front, side and elevated-rear frames; an independent reviewer records continue or rollback before another pass
review_gate.acceptance: literal primary overlay and normal visual review are mandatory; scalar metrics diagnose only and cannot accept or rank the mesh
